contract: A23-74 (user 2026-10-07 "점점 합쳐지겠다"): body radius = 1.5 x Scale (Slime shape) / 1.25 x Scale (Humanoid); a chaser's goal is its slot on a ring r + 1 + 1 (<= AttackRange - 0.5) around its target, centred 0.25 s ahead of a walking player (at most 4 studs); slots of one player's chasers spread (order kept, least movement) so ring neighbours stand rA + rB apart; when they do not fit, the inner ring moves out to AttackRange - 0.5 (10 Shard Slimes in reach) and the rest wait on further rings outside reach, each RingGap outside the bodies of the ring before (30 slimes: 10 + 18 + 2); a slot on water falls back to the player's position. In reach a monster stands for its swing (pending wind-up or cooldown up), within 0.5 of its slot or when the slot is inside the player body, else it steps on to its slot (AutoRotate off while in reach). After every AI tick the end points of the coming walks (_walkTo at WalkSpeed) are pushed apart in up to 3 rounds where bodies would overlap (rA + rB, the smaller one moving more, a boss never) or a body would be inside a player (r + 1 around where the player will be); each push becomes a slide over that tick at most 8 studs/s, never into water / past the zone move inset / through a wall (half step tried), and a walking monster's MoveTo point moves along; pushes under 0.05 are ignored; neighbours come from an 8-stud grid; a new monster spawns at least rA + rB + 1.5 from every living one, else the first crowded ground point; SpawnEvent (bosses) keeps the same clearance within its radius, else its spot (the slides clear it). Review probe: walking 3 / 5 / 8 studs/s with 4 Shard + 2 King Slimes, mean deepest overlap per AI tick < 0.3 studs. Review 2026-10-08: a zone monster's slide keeps its part along the zone's move line (ZONE_MOVE_INSET inside the zone edge) and drops only the part crossing it, checked all the way from where the body stands to its MoveTo point; the other monster of a pair takes the dropped part; a body pinned on the line leaves a player body along it (the other side when its own is blocked); a MoveTo point moved along a slide stays inside the line with room for the rest of the slide; a player's rings count only their arc inside the line (around where the player will be), fewer fit and the rest wait on the next ring, so no slot needs clamping (a player 3 studs past the line: 6 chasers, none touching, old clamped slots 2.6 studs inside each other); a ring with no room keeps its closest one and the next ring starts outside where aiStep clamps it (zone corners, a running player); a player with a personal monster among its chasers keeps whole rings; a zone monster keeps its target 2 s (never switching again sooner), then switches only to a player 3 studs closer, or when its target is out of AttackRange and another player is in reach (idle in the other player's reach at most those 2 s); right after a taunt (SKL-3) the nearest one, no hold. Two players 2 / 4 studs apart, standing or walking together: with 4 Shard + 2 King Slimes no switch within 2 s and at most half the old rule's switches; with a crowd of 12 Shard + 4 King Slimes (16 runs of 40 s) monsters still change target now and then (switches about 20% and A -> B -> A about 14% of the nearest-every-tick rule's, none within 2 s), swing >= 90% as often and pile up about as much (mean deepest overlap <= 1.25x the old rule's). Monster parts stay CanCollide = false.
limitations: Roots, Humanoids (MoveTo / WalkSpeed / AutoRotate), the ground ray, walls, Random and the player list are doubles; the simulations use a stand-in for aiStep / attack (walk at Def.Speed x the NATURAL ramp, a wind-up of MonsterWindup s, a Humanoid that stops once it reached its MoveTo point) around the real SEP passes (with aiStep's real zone clamp, and the real SEP.Pick for several players). Real Humanoid MoveTo / AutoRotate behaviour, replication smoothness of the server slides, the FACE turn while stepping sideways and the Tripo mesh footprints are only checkable in Studio Play (game dev 1). SEP.Need sorting ties by id (like Spread) is asserted but has no mutation: Luau's table.sort happens to order the test ties the same way with an angle-only comparator. Review 2026-10-08: each player's rings know neither the other players' bodies nor their chasers' slots (cutting them by the bodies left most chasers of a 3-4 player group out of reach), so a slot can lie inside another player and around players 2 studs apart the two inner rings overlap: the body push and the slides take that, and in a crowd a monster may change target about every few seconds (never within 2 s). A zone's chasers are assumed to share the player's zone (targetable); the rings take the first zone chaser's rect. SEP.Arc keeps only the longest free piece when a narrow zone cuts a ring twice (no game zone is that narrow).
